subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world volume word problems using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student designs a simple container/tank with virtual blocks and calculates its volume or capacity
exercise.pictorial: Student draws and labels a diagram to represent a one-step volume word problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a one-step volume word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot translate word problem language into the correct volume model/formula

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
